added.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About The Product Team

The Product team listens to our customers’ needs and translates those insights into a clear product vision. The team works closely with design, engineering, and analytics to build scalable financial products that empower people to manage their money with confidence. We rely on empathy, curiosity, and business sense to prioritize features and improve experiences. Our role is to lead with clarity, support cross-functional execution, and champion the user in every decision.

About The Role

The Consumer Payments team powers how customers successfully make payments to Affirm. As a Senior Product Manager, you will create new payment experiences that make repaying easier, improve payment success, and define how payments are processed safely and cost-effectively. This is a highly cross-functional role that sits at the intersection of Product, Engineering, Analytics, Finance, Design, and Partnerships.

What You’ll Do

We are looking for a curious, collaborative Senior Product Manager to improve how customers pay with Affirm.

We are looking for a curious, collaborative Senior Product Manager to improve how customers pay with Affirm
Focus on the customer, uncovering where paying breaks down through research and data, and sharing those insights across the team
Create new payment experiences that make repaying easier, working with Design and Analytics from discovery to launch
Design and run experiments that improve conversion, payment success, and cost
Shape how payments are processed safely and cost-effectively, weighing performance and risk
Be a trusted partner to Product, Engineering, Finance, Design, and Partnerships, exploring new opportunities together, evaluating their impact, and defining sequencing
Drive an ambitious roadmap that delivers customer and business outcomes by identifying the highest-impact bets and presenting strategy to senior leaders

What We Look For

5+ years of product management experience
Analytical rigor: you are comfortable in the data and use experiment results and customer research to make product decisions
Curiosity about customers: you have strong instincts for where an experience breaks down and the drive to fix it
Experience holding informed conversations with engineers about how systems work and the tradeoffs they carry
A track record of taking products from discovery through launch and iteration, including turning ambiguous or conflicting inputs into a clear plan
Clear communication and influence: you explain tradeoffs well and build trust and alignment across Product, Engineering, Finance, Design, and Partnerships, including senior leaders, without needing formal authority
Bonus points for experience in payments, fintech, or e-commerce

added.description:
We are seeking an outcome-driven Vice President, Product Strategy & Commercialization to own an assigned product portfolio from opportunity identification through commercialization and growth. This role is responsible for ensuring customer needs, market opportunities, product investments, and commercialization efforts remain aligned around a common strategy and deliver measurable business outcomes.  
Reporting to the Chief Product Officer, this leader will work across product, technical, design, and go-to-market functions to identify growth opportunities, guide investment decisions, and translate strategy into measurable customer and business outcomes. This role combines strategic leadership with hands-on ownership of portfolio performance and market success. While the role does not have formal authority over Engineering, Sales, Marketing, or Customer Experience, it is accountable for aligning those functions around shared portfolio objectives and outcomes.  
Success in this role is defined not by the volume of features delivered, but by the ability to create market impact, accelerate growth, strengthen customer outcomes, and turn strategic investments into measurable results.  
  What You'll Own

Portfolio Strategy & Growth

Define the strategy and long-term direction for an assigned product portfolio.  

Balance investments across core offerings, growth opportunities, and emerging innovations.  

Evaluate portfolio tradeoffs and make recommendations regarding investment, acceleration, incubation, partnership, acquisition, or retirement.  

Ensure portfolio priorities remain aligned to customer needs, market conditions, and company objectives.  

Partner with executive leadership on portfolio planning, resource allocation, and growth initiatives.  

  Portfolio Performance

Own or materially influence product-line economics, revenue performance, pricing strategy, investment decisions, forecast inputs, and growth initiatives.  

Drive measurable outcomes across bookings, adoption, retention, expansion, win rate, and customer impact.  

Ensure every major investment has a clear path from strategy to market success.  

Monitor market performance and adjust priorities based on customer, competitive, and business signals.  

Partner with Sales, Marketing, Customer Experience, Finance, and executive leadership to maximize portfolio performance.  

  Innovation & Commercialization

Partner closely with innovation and technical leaders to evaluate emerging opportunities and bring successful concepts to market.  

Establish clear criteria for deciding when innovations should be productized, scaled, partnered, deferred, or discontinued.  

Drive the transition from concept to validation, productization, commercialization, and growth.  

Ensure innovation investments generate meaningful customer value and measurable business outcomes.  

Leverage AI and automation opportunities where appropriate to accelerate growth, differentiation, and operational effectiveness.  

  Customer & Market Leadership

Maintain a deep understanding of customer needs, market trends, competitive dynamics, and emerging opportunities.  

Ensure customer insights, market intelligence, and competitive signals directly inform portfolio decisions.  

Champion customer outcomes throughout the product lifecycle.  

Drive positioning, differentiation, and commercialization strategies that strengthen market performance and competitive advantage.  

Help shape compelling narratives that connect product capabilities with customer and business outcomes.  

  Cross-Functional Leadership

Align Product Management, Product Marketing, AI Innovation, Technical Leadership, and Design & Research around a shared portfolio strategy.  

Lead and coach senior Product Management and Product Marketing individual contributors to drive aligned execution and outcomes.  

Foster strong alignment between product investments, customer needs, technical capabilities, and commercial execution.  

Create clarity around priorities, tradeoffs, ownership, and success measures.  

Influence across functions without relying solely on formal authority.  

  Executive Leadership

Present portfolio strategy, performance, opportunities, and risks to executive leadership.  

Contribute to strategic planning, investment discussions, and long-term growth initiatives.  

Support customer briefings, analyst interactions, industry events, and thought leadership activities when appropriate.  

Help communicate the role of the portfolio within the company's broader product, AI, and growth strategy.  

What Success Looks Like

Portfolio investments are focused on the highest-value customer and business opportunities.  

Product, commercialization, and innovation efforts operate as an integrated system.  

New opportunities consistently move from concept to market impact.  

Customers achieve measurable outcomes from portfolio investments.  

Product launches drive adoption, retention, expansion, and revenue growth.  

Emerging opportunities are successfully converted into differentiated products and capabilities.  

The portfolio develops a strong and differentiated market position.  
Cross-functional teams are aligned around shared goals, priorities, and business outcomes.  

Qualifications

12+ years of leadership experience across Product Management, Product Marketing, Product Strategy, General Management, or related B2B SaaS disciplines.  

Proven success driving products, portfolios, or businesses from strategy through commercialization and growth.  

Candidates may originate in Product Management, Product Marketing, or General Management, but must demonstrate deep expertise in one discipline and meaningful operating ownership in the other.  

Strong understanding of commercialization, market positioning, customer value creation, and business performance.  

Experience owning or materially influencing product-line economics, pricing, investment decisions, growth initiatives, or commercial outcomes.  

Demonstrated ability to connect customer needs, product strategy, and go-to-market execution.  

Technical fluency sufficient to engage credibly with modern SaaS platforms, APIs, AI technologies, automation, and engineering teams.  

Exceptional cross-functional leadership and executive communication skills.  

Experience presenting recommendations, business cases, portfolio strategies, or investment proposals to senior leadership.  

Board, analyst, or investor-facing experience is helpful but not required.  

Experience in accessibility, compliance, developer platforms, workflow software, AI-enabled products, or adjacent enterprise software markets is helpful but not required.

Lead, manage, and develop a team of Product Owners, operating as a hands-on player-coach who works directly alongside the team on real product work and who is accountable for the team’s growth, performance, and delivery

Overview

The Director, Product Management - Technical Services is responsible for the oversight, implementation, and maintenance of Workers' Compensation products, regulatory compliance activities, bureau and state filings, and supporting business systems. This role serves as a critical liaison between Product Management, Underwriting, Actuarial, Operations, and Information Technology to ensure regulatory changes, product enhancements, and business requirements are accurately interpreted, implemented, tested, and maintained.

The Director is responsible for monitoring industry and regulatory developments, evaluating operational and system impacts, and driving implementation activities that support organizational objectives while ensuring compliance. In addition, this role owns the ongoing integrity of Workers' Compensation systems and configurations, ensuring that rates, rules, forms, underwriting guidelines, and product filings are accurately reflected within company systems and operating as intended. The position plays a key role in identifying, investigating, documenting, and resolving system issues, working closely with Information Technology and business stakeholders to prioritize enhancements, address defects, and continuously improve operational performance.

This position requires a strong combination of product expertise, regulatory knowledge, analytical capability, technical aptitude, and leadership skills to successfully manage product implementations, maintain system accuracy, and support strategic business initiatives

This position is hybrid out of any AmTrust office. 4 days in the office, 1 day work from home.

Responsibilities

Monitor and evaluate Workers' Compensation bureau circulars, regulatory bulletins, legislative updates, and industry developments to identify business impacts and implementation requirements.
Manage the review, preparation, submission, and maintenance of Workers' Compensation product filings, including rates, rules, forms, and related regulatory documentation.
Serve as a subject matter expert on Workers' Compensation products, regulatory requirements, and bureau environments, including NCCI and independent bureau states.
Ensure company systems accurately reflect approved product filings, rates, rules, forms, underwriting guidelines, and business requirements.
Monitor system performance and product implementation outcomes to ensure compliance, operational effectiveness, and alignment with business objectives.
Investigate system discrepancies, operational concerns, and production issues; perform root cause analysis and determine appropriate corrective actions.
Partner closely with Information Technology to document, prioritize, test, and resolve system defects, enhancements, and configuration issues.
Develop and maintain business requirements, implementation documentation, testing plans, and procedural controls supporting product and system changes.
Lead and coordinate testing activities, including User Acceptance Testing (UAT), to validate system functionality and implementation accuracy.
Utilize data and reporting tools, including advanced Microsoft Excel, to analyze business results, validate implementations, monitor performance, and support decision-making.
Collaborate with Product Management, Underwriting, Actuarial, Operations, Claims, and Information Technology teams to successfully implement business and regulatory initiatives.
Identify opportunities to improve processes, enhance system functionality, strengthen controls, and increase operational efficiency.
Lead or support cross-functional projects and provide guidance on product, regulatory, operational, and technical matters.
Manage, coach, and develop team members, including performance management, prioritization of work, training, and professional development.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Business, Insurance, Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or a related field; equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.
Minimum 5 years of experience in Workers' Compensation insurance with a strong background in Product Management, Underwriting, Technical Services, Regulatory Compliance, or a related discipline.
Demonstrated knowledge of Workers' Compensation rating, pricing, underwriting, regulatory filings, bureau rules, and policy administration processes.
Experience utilizing Workers' Compensation bureau websites and resources (NCCI and independent bureau states) to research rules, rates, forms, and filing requirements.
Experience monitoring industry circulars, regulatory bulletins, and bureau communications to identify and assess business impacts, compliance requirements, product changes, and implementation needs.
Strong understanding of insurance systems, workflows, and operational impacts associated with product and regulatory changes.
Advanced Microsoft Excel proficiency, including the ability to create and maintain complex formulas, analyze and reconcile large datasets, develop pivot tables, perform data validation, and generate meaningful reports and dashboards to support business decisions.
Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify issues, evaluate impacts, and recommend effective solutions.
Strong written, verbal, and presentation communication skills with the ability to communicate complex concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and successfully execute projects in a fast-paced environment.
Experience collaborating across departments, including Product, Underwriting, Actuarial, Compliance, Operations, and Information Technology.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy, particularly in regulatory, system, and product implementation activities.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience managing Workers' Compensation product filings and interactions with state regulatory agencies.
Extensive knowledge of NCCI and independent bureau state environments, including interpretation and implementation of bureau and regulatory changes.
Project management experience leading cross-functional initiatives from planning through implementation.
Experience validating system changes, conducting user acceptance testing (UAT), and supporting production implementations.
Working knowledge of SQL and the ability to query and analyze data to support product and operational decision-making.
Experience with business intelligence, reporting, or data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.
Demonstrated ability to identify process improvement opportunities and implement solutions that increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.
Previous leadership experience, including coaching, mentoring, or directing the work of analysts and other team members.
